name: pr-watch
description: Watch pull requests from a session: when CI fails or a merge conflict appears, wake this same session to fix it and push, with no cloud session. A footer button sums up each PR's state and opens a side panel to watch, check and stop PRs; /pr-watch does the same.

intervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often each watched PR is checked with gh. One gh call per PR per poll.

allowPush.title: Push fixes
allowPush.description: Tell Claude it may push its fixes to the watched PR's branch (never force-push or merge). Off: Claude commits and asks before pushing.

fixCi.title: Fix failing CI
fixCi.description: Wake the session when the checks on a PR's head commit have finished and some failed.

fixConflicts.title: Fix merge conflicts
fixConflicts.description: Wake the session when GitHub reports a PR conflicts with its base branch.

maxAttempts.title: Fix attempts per PR
maxAttempts.description: How many times in a row Claude is asked to fix one PR before pr-watch stops asking; it starts over once the PR is green.
